# The Valley Desk

> Find and follow healthcare research connected to the nine-county Delaware Valley.

- [Research directory](https://thevalleydesk.org/discover/works): search regional listings.
- [New listings](https://thevalleydesk.org/discover/new): ordered by directory addition date.
- [Listings JSON](https://thevalleydesk.org/api/directory/listings): paginated research additions with the same filters as the feed.
- [RSS](https://thevalleydesk.org/discover/updates.xml): filter by institution, topic, county or kind.
- [Methodology](https://thevalleydesk.org/discover/methodology): definitions, corrections, removal and coverage.
- [Directory JSON](https://thevalleydesk.org/api/directory/projects): public project catalog. Use /api/directory/projects/{id} for one repository.
- [Sitemap](https://thevalleydesk.org/sitemap.xml)

A Verified project has a source that ties the exact repository to the region. A Listed project has an observed connection through its account or lab. Consult the linked sources for the scope of each connection.
